children: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF entered into the Sixth Amendment to its Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital, adding the Trust as a party to receive custody services for a portion of its AVAX holdings. Coinbase remains the primary custodian, while the Sponsor will allocate AVAX between custodians at its discretion. The move supports risk management as the Trust grows and provides additional institutional-grade custody options, with Anchorage maintaining U.S.-based HSM key storage and insurance coverage.
